Specification of Programmable Paper Cutting Machine Product/Item Description/Specification Type of Machine Programmable Paper Cutting Machine Cutting Width ≥1150 mm Feed Depth ≥1150 mm Clamp Opening ≥160 mm Smallest Cut without false clamp ≤30 mm Smallest Cut with false clamp ≤90 mm Clamp Pressure (Minimum) ≤500 kg Clamp Pressure (Maximum) ≥3000 kg

No. of Cut in continuous run ≥40 cuts/min Front table Length ≥700 mm Table Height ≥800 mm Back gauge Speed (Normal) ≥40 mm/sec Back gauge Speed (Express) ≥100 mm/sec Position Accuracy (Min.) ≤0.01 mm Number of Programs ≥90 Number of Steps/Program ≥90 Display Type ≥09 inch Touch Screen Supply Current - Phase 3 phase ≤440 V Power Required (Main drive) ≥1.5 kW Total Power required ≥3 kW Weight ≥3000 Kg Required Features & Accessories: 1. Construction of the machine must be rigid & sturdy for heavy-duty appl ication. 2. The machine should confirm to E.U. Machinery Directive 98/37/CE Certi ficate/EN/VDE Guidelines/Equivalent ISO Certification and applicable stre ngth & safety regulation. 3. Slotless bed (Machine bed) for precise and accurate cutting. 4. Appropriate capacity air compressor with required accessories must be supplied. 5. Non-corrosive machine table with sufficient air cushioning for easy mo vement of stock. 6. Touch screen display for multiple programming steps and machine fun ctions. 7. Hydraulic pressure drive for cutting and clamping. 8. All setting should be done automatically through program. 9. On line bypass facility with digital positioning system.

10. Clamp pressure should be adjustable for variety of papers. 11. Operator friendly and safe knife changing system. 12. Optical cut line indicator. 13. Double pressure system for pressure clamp. First pressure will release t he air from the Stock and second pressure will tighten the grip while cutting to get a perfect cut. 14. The TFT touch screen control architecture shall incorporate system- level baseline infrastructure and structural data-handling readiness for e xternal digital data layout profiles, engineered to natively accommodate standard CIP3/CIP4 data file imports through network and USB channels. 15. Appropriate voltage stabilizer as per machine requirement shall be pro vided with the machine. 16. Set of tools required to operate and maintain the machine. 17. Extra Spares: Knife Set-02 Nos. and Cutting Sticks -12 Nos. 18. Two row photocell safety devices ensure machine operation with safety back-up all the times. 19. Two push button machine operation with safety back-up all the times. N.B. for Machine: 1. Safety device required in the machine as per International Safety Reg ulations. 2. Minimum One-year On Site OEM warranty period should be given for t he machine from the date of Installation. 3. Operator’s Manual and Maintenance Manual 2 Sets must be given at t he time of installation of the machine. 4. Electrical and Electronic Diagrams/Circuit Board diagram must be sup plied with the machine. 5. Training: Minimum of four to five working days training after installation of the machine. 6. Maintenance: The Supplier shall have to provide free maintenance a nd services without parts and consumables for Two year after warranty period and then after as mutually agreed terms and conditions. Scope of Work The scope of this GeM Bid includes the supply, installation, testing, commissioni ng, and training for operation of a Programmable Paper Cutting Machine at the Department’s premises. The supplier shall also provide warranty and after-s ales service support as detailed in this document. Terms and Conditions 1. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): All Bidders shall be required to submit EMD. In case of any claim for EMD exemp tion under the applicable GeM Terms and Conditions, the MSE/MSME registratio n certificate or any other relevant exemption certificate submitted by the bidder

must specifically cover the manufacturing of the item being procured i.e. Progr ammable Paper Cutting Machine. Certificates not covering the said category an d specifications shall not be considered valid for EMD exemption..” 2. Experience Certificate: The bidder must submit an experience certificate of at least three (03) years fro m a Government or Semi-Government department, demonstrating their past pe rformance in the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of a Program mable Paper Cutting Machine. 3. Make and Model of Machine: The make and model of the quoted machine must be clearly specified in the bid . The bidder shall ensure that the machine supplied is of the same make and m odel as quoted. 4. Warranty: The machine shall be supplied with a comprehensive warranty of at least 12 m onths from the date of successful installation and commissioning. During the w arranty period, the bidder shall provide free replacement/repair of defective par ts and free technical support. 5. Delivery Period: The machine shall be delivered, installed, tested, and commissioned within 30 days from the date of issuance of the supply order. 6. Penalty for Delay: In case of delay in supply, installation, or commissioning beyond the stipulated period, a penalty of 0.5% of the total contract value per week of delay, su bject to a maximum of 10%, shall be imposed. 7. Training: The supplier shall provide on-site training for a period of Five (5) days to the de partment’s staff/operators covering operation, safety, and routine maintenance of the machine, at no additional cost.” 8. After-Sales Service: The bidder must ensure the availability of after-sales service, technical support,

and spare parts for at least five (05) years from the date of installation. A serv ice centre/contact details must be provided. 9. Payment Terms: Payment shall be released after the successful delivery, installation, testing, an d commissioning of the machine, against verification and acceptance by the co mpetent authority. 10. Force Majeure: The bidder shall not be held liable for delays or failure in execution due to circu mstances beyond their reasonable control (e.g., natural calamities, strikes, war, etc.). However, the department must be duly informed in writing within 7 days of such events. 11. Dispute Resolution/ Settlement of Dispute In case of any dispute arises, the decision of the Administrative Secretary to the Government, ARI & Trainings Department shall be binding on both the parties. Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) – Terms & Conditions (i) Scope of Inspection: Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) shall cover physical verification, functional t esting, and quality checks of the machine/equipment and accessories fixed/installed in the machine strictly as per approved specifications, drawi ngs, and contractual terms. (ii) Inspection Authority: Inspection shall be carried out by an NABCB(National Accreditation Bo ard for Certification Bodies)- accredited Third- Party Inspection Agency, u nder the Quality Control of India(QCI), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India (iii) Place of Inspection: Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) shall be cond ucted at the manufacturer’s/supplier’s premises prior to shipment of Mach inery. (iv) Notice for Inspection: Supplier shall give at least 7 (sev en) working days’ advance written notice to the Buyer/Inspection Agency for scheduling the inspection.

(v) Facilities for Inspection: Supplier s hall provide, free of cost, all tools, instruments, gauges, test equipment, r aw material, and skilled personnel required for inspection and testing of t he machine. (vi) Inspection Charges All expenses for Pre-Dispatch Inspection at supplier’s premises shall be bo rne by the Supplier. Third-party inspection charges shall be borne as per P urchase Order/Contract terms. (vii) Rejection & Rectification: Items found defective/non-conforming shall be rectified or replaced by the Supplier at their own cost. Re-inspection, if required, shall also be borne by the Supplier. (viii) Inspection Report / Clearance Certificate: Dispatch of Machinery shall only be allowed after successful inspection an d issue of clearance Certificate by the inspecting authority. (ix) Packing & Marking Verification: Pre-Dispatch Inspection shall include verification of packing, labelling, and marking for safe transportation and contractual compliance. (x) Consignee’s Right of Rejection: As per the applicable Government General Terms & Conditions (GTC), the consignee reserves the right to reject the goods at the final destination if they are found defective, non-conforming, or not meeting contractual spe cifications. This right shall in no way be limited or waived by reason of the goods having previously been inspected, tested, and passed by the nomin ated external Inspecting Agency prior to shipment. (xi) Final Acceptance: Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) clearance shall not absolve Supplier of res ponsibility for quality, performance and warranty/guarantee obligations. Final acceptance shall be given only after successful installation, commiss ioning, survey by departmental survey committee and performance at Bu yer’s site. 2. The bidder shall offer the machine strictly in accordance with the specifications, features, acces sories and N.B specified in the attached ATC PDF and ATC text clauses. The bidder shall clearly me ntion the Make and Model of the Machine offered against the prescribed requirements. 3, EMD, if already deposited against the earlier cancelled bid for the same purpose, shall be consid

ered subject to validity and verification. . 16. Past Project Experience The Bidder / OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)}, should have executed project for supply and installation / commissioning of same or similar Category Products during preceding 3 financial years (i.e. current year and three previous financial years) as on opening of bid, as per following criteria: (i) Single order of at least 35% of estimated bid value; or (ii) Two orders of at least 20% each of estimated bid value; or (iii) Three orders of at least 15% each of estimated bid value. Satisfactory Performance certificate issued by respective Buyer Organization for the above Orders should be uploaded with bid. In case of bunch bids, the Category related to primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion 17.
